moeObjectiveLeads.text: Demonstrate public speaking skills Different kinds of letters
Analyze and write poems using literary devices and figurative language

findings.evidence: Flesch-Kincaid grade 11.6 for a grade 6 lesson
findings.issue: Sentence and word length suggest the text is harder to read than the grade allows.
findings.proposedCorrection: Shorten sentences and gloss vocabulary without lowering the conceptual demand; confirm with a language reviewer.

findings.evidence: no route stated for learners who lack the prerequisite
findings.issue: The prerequisite is mentioned but not diagnosed with a fallback, so learners without it fall behind unseen.
findings.proposedCorrection: Turn activation into a diagnostic item per prerequisite and state what happens when a learner misses it.

findings.evidence: no item carries response-specific feedback or a misconception-mapped distractor
findings.issue: Wrong answers cannot be diagnosed or corrected by cause.
findings.proposedCorrection: Map each distractor or response pattern to a catalogued misconception with corrective feedback.

findings.evidence: no explain/justify/compare prompt in independent work or assessment
findings.issue: Learners are never asked to produce reasoning, only answers.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add a constructed-response reasoning or performance task at scaffold NONE scored by a rubric.

findings.where: delivery.body#s16 "17. Assessment, Exit Ticket, and Lesson Summary" (line 274)
findings.evidence: 0 of 5 assessment prompts have an answer or scoring key
findings.issue: Unkeyed items cannot be scored consistently or verified for correctness.
findings.proposedCorrection: Write a protected key or rubric for every item and verify each key independently.

findings.evidence: no task marked as a new context, representation or genre
findings.issue: Learners are only tested in rehearsed contexts, so transfer is unknown.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an unscaffolded transfer task in a context the lesson did not rehearse (GE-TRN-1).

findings.evidence: "According to the basic economic principle of supply and demand, if the supply decreases and demand remains constant, prices will rise."
findings.issue: A factual or statistical claim is stated without a source; it may be invented.
findings.proposedCorrection: Verify against a named, dated source and cite it, or remove it or label it as an invented example.

findings.evidence: 1 code(s) not in the MOE structured source, e.g. LR-LIT-G4_6-01 (method: keyword)
findings.issue: Alignment codes are LiberiaLearn-invented labels, not MOE objectives; they must not be presented as MOE requirements.
findings.proposedCorrection: Map each objective to a structured MOE objective id with source page, reviewed by a curriculum owner; lexical leads are attached to this audit.

findings.issue: Ready learners have nowhere to go beyond the objective.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an optional, non-gating extension clearly labelled as beyond grade scope.
